free_parameters.name: batch_size
free_parameters.why: witness_hint does not specify batch size; the entry requires batch size 1 and the target condition reads only head counts

free_parameters.name: q_len
free_parameters.why: witness_hint does not specify sequence length; q_len > 1 avoids the decode branch and q_len <= 2*block_size takes the short-sequence path to triton_flash_prefill where the target lives

free_parameters.name: k_len
free_parameters.why: witness_hint does not specify k length; the entry asserts q.shape[1] == k.shape[1], so k_len must equal q_len

free_parameters.name: head_dim
free_parameters.why: witness_hint does not specify head dim; 32 is one of the four values the pre-target guard accepts and keeps tensors small on CPU

free_parameters.name: gamma
free_parameters.why: required positional argument of the entry; the short-sequence branch is chosen before any coverage logic reads it

free_parameters.name: block_size
free_parameters.why: entry default and an accepted value; q_len=2 <= 2*block_size selects the short-sequence branch that reaches the target

free_parameters.name: dtype
free_parameters.why: triton_flash_prefill asserts q.dtype == torch.bfloat16 at line 244, before the target at line 247; CPU torch supports bfloat16 tensor construction

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixed seed makes the random q/k/v construction deterministic across repeats
